observation: A PowerShell ref probe recurred AER-0299 by embedding a semicolon-delimited Git and conditional sequence inside a parenthesized assignment. Parsing failed before any statement executed.
containment: No filesystem, Git, provider, runtime or product action occurred.
The corrected probe used one statement per line, captured LASTEXITCODE in named scalars and verified the exact task ancestry and protected refs.
All remaining Git, ref and worktree probes in this tranche use newline-separated scalar assignments only.
